policy: FAIL-CLOSED PROVENANCE MANIFEST — the single shared copy of the approved NS-3 deployment digests. Consumed by BOTH .github/workflows/ci.yml (anchor-build provenance gate) and scripts/devnet/deploy_devnet.sh (pre-deploy gate) via scripts/devnet/ns3_verify_provenance.mjs. NEVER bump a digest to make a failing check pass: a digest change means the deployed bytes change, and it is only legitimate after the new build has been independently reviewed and deliberately re-approved in a reviewed PR (any source, dependency, toolchain, or arch change shifts the digests).
source: PR #82 CI provenance gate (merge a71158edba7be42a2a0195bf95c24c863090bd44); digests recorded from the deploy-flow build of the NS-3 tree (NS-3 rehearsal correction report §8)

sbpf.note: The deployment flow (plain cargo-build-sbf, ANCHOR_BUILD_SBF_ARCH=v0) builds the default v0 target: triple sbpf-solana-solana, e_machine 263 / e_flags 0. anchor 1.2.2's own default (v3: e_machine 247 / e_flags 3) is REFUSED — the arch must match the deploy flow, not anchor's default (DR-001/NS-2).

platformTools.note: Solana CLI 3.0.10's bundled platform-tools v1.51 (cargo 1.84) cannot parse edition2024 manifests, and anchor 1.2.2 passes --tools-version v1.57; CI pre-seeds every cache directory cargo-build-sbf may resolve with the hash-verified v1.54 contents. The toolchain that produced the approved ELFs is v1.54 (rustc 1.89.0-dev).
